verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only standard performance reports and developer-facing AI tooling (an agent picking up the CLI and file contract, and schema introspection). None of it documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from store data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
